question: Could you help me calculate the average single career span value in years for all baseball players? Please precise the result as a float number. First, calculate the difference in years, months, and days between the debut and final game dates. For each player, the career span is computed as the sum of the absolute number of years, plus the absolute number of months divided by 12, plus the absolute number of days divided by 365. Round each part to two decimal places before summing. Finally, average the career spans and round the result to a float number.
sql:
WITH player_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(debut AS DATE) AS deb_date,
    CAST(final_game AS DATE) AS fin_date
  FROM player 
  WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND debut != '' AND final_game IS NOT NULL AND final_game != ''
),
diff_base AS (
  SELECT 
    deb_date,
    fin_date,
    CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fin_date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM deb_date) AS INTEGER) AS raw_years,
    CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM fin_date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM deb_date) AS INTEGER) AS raw_months,
    CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM fin_date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM deb_date) AS INTEGER) AS raw_days,
    CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (date_trunc('MONTH', deb_date) + INTERVAL 1 MONTH - INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS INTEGER) AS days_in_deb_month
  FROM player_dates
),
diff_adj AS (
  SELECT 
    deb_date,
    fin_date,
    raw_years,
    raw_months,
    raw_days,
    CASE WHEN raw_days < 0 THEN raw_months - 1 ELSE raw_months END AS adj_months,
    CASE WHEN raw_days < 0 THEN raw_days + days_in_deb_month ELSE raw_days END AS adj_days
  FROM diff_base
),
diff_final AS (
  SELECT 
    deb_date,
    fin_date,
    CASE WHEN CAST(adj_months AS INTEGER) < 0 THEN raw_years - 1 ELSE raw_years END AS years,
    CASE WHEN CAST(adj_months AS INTEGER) < 0 THEN CAST(adj_months AS INTEGER) + 12 ELSE CAST(adj_months AS INTEGER) END AS months,
    CAST(adj_days AS INTEGER) AS days
  FROM diff_adj
),
career_spans AS (
  SELECT 
    ABS(ROUND(CAST(years AS DOUBLE), 2)) + ABS(ROUND(CAST(months AS DOUBLE), 2)) / 12.0 + ABS(ROUND(CAST(days AS DOUBLE), 2)) / 365.0 AS career_span
  FROM diff_final
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(career_span), 2) AS avg_career_span
FROM career_spans
